title: The Borrowed Coat
text:
Maria had worked at the bakery for twenty years, yet she had never once asked the owner for a raise. One winter morning, a young assistant noticed that she was wearing the same thin coat she had worn for a decade. He quietly bought her a warm one and left it on the counter. Maria did not know who had done this, and the story never tells us whether she ever found out.

The following week, Maria wore the coat to work and said nothing about it. Customers began to notice her new appearance and asked where she had found it. She simply smiled and continued serving bread, as if kindness were something that needed no explanation. The young assistant watched from the back room and felt a quiet satisfaction.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, how long had Maria worked at the bakery?
According to the second paragraph, what did Maria do when customers asked about the coat?
options: She told them the owner had bought it
She simply smiled and kept serving bread
She refused to wear the coat again
She asked them to pay for it

questions.text: What does the young assistant's action most suggest about his character?
options: He is generous and acts without seeking recognition
He wants to be promoted to manager
He is angry that Maria never complained
He is trying to make Maria leave the bakery

questions.text: Why does Maria's smile suggest that she values kindness?
options: She treats the gift as something that needs no explanation or thanks
She is embarrassed and wants to hide her feelings
She plans to repay the assistant with money
She is happy only because the coat is expensive

vocabulary.definition: in a calm way that does not attract attention
people who buy goods or services from a business
a feeling of pleasure from having done or received something good

paragraph_translations: Maria fırında yirmi yıl çalışmıştı, ama sahibinden bir kez bile zam istememişti. Bir kış sabahı genç bir çırak, onun on yıldır giydiği ince paltoyu hâlâ giydiğini fark etti. Sessizce ona sıcak bir palto aldı ve tezgâhın üstüne bıraktı. Maria bunu kimin yaptığını bilmiyordu ve hikâye, bunu hiç öğrenip öğrenmediğini bize söylemiyor.

Ertesi hafta Maria paltoyu işe giydi ve bu konuda hiçbir şey söylemedi. Müşteriler yeni görünümünü fark etmeye başladı ve nereden aldığını sordu. Maria sadece gülümsedi ve ekmek satmaya devam etti, sanki nezaketin açıklamaya ihtiyacı yokmuş gibi. Genç çırak arka odadan izledi ve sessiz bir memnuniyet duydu.
